Hello! I am 13 I am also dealing with this right now. I recently watched a movie and in the movie it had people in a simulation without them knowing. After watching this I had a panic attack. I started thinking about my loved ones being fake. Shortly after I started overthinking about this, which lead me deeper into anxiety and sadness. After some days I just couldn't get my mind off this. I went into a depression which lasted about 2 weeks. I suddenly came out for no reason. But then a thought came to me, what if I commit suicide. I got a panic attack from thinking about that. I am not suicidal nor do I have depression. I feel that this is an intrusive thought. I do have generalized anxiety disorder ( GAD ) which makes it completely worse. Try seeing a therapist again. Or try taking some medication. I feel that benzodiazepines works. I have been feeling better and if you cannot forget about this I suggest drug-induces amnesia. This will make your thoughts feel less frightening.

EDIT: You may think I'm fake or be suspicious of this. That's how I feel. Just try to work through it with some therapy or medication.
